label: Vendor onboarding — prepayment to a first-time industrial supplier

open_case.context: Prepayment of USD 250,000 for a first-time bulk order of machined parts, 60-day lead time, no escrow, no prior trading history.
open_case.criteria: ["Operates a real business with verifiable customers or shipments","Registered legal entity verifiable in a public registry","Ownership and control are disclosed","No unresolved disputes, claims or enforcement actions","Physical address and contact details resolve to the stated entity","Trading history long enough for a USD 250k prepayment"]

notes: Criteria are the consensus surface: rulings return unmet_criteria as indices into this exact array, so reordering it changes the meaning of past rulings.
